overview.text: Sue Elhessen is a disability rights advocate with a doctorate in education who served on the Bellflower Unified school board for nine years. During her first term on the school board, she started a Cerritos College dual-enrollment bridge program for students with disabilities. In 2022, she proposed a bylaw to end board meetings at 9 p.m. as an accommodation under the Americans with Disabilities Act.
